checks.integrity: The fixed dock, full-height fader geometry, A/B divider, performance-panel/contact sources, R34/R35/R37 analysis and preparation match the baseline. ReplicaView changes are confined to LoadSlider.
checks.review: Self-review under the project rule against parallel agents.
checks.harnessScope: The browser harness compiles production column, contact and loader sources. It removes the TDJCore import from a temporary copy and uses the exact DeckID enum declaration from Models.swift. The signed iPad build checks the full module integration.

behaviour: Categories, playlists and detail/prep use the shared TouchPanelState and dedicated 44-point horizontal grab lanes.
Each column retains independent session widths for portrait and landscape. Search temporarily frees the left column without changing its width.
The song list reserves 240 points. In narrow layouts, explicit opening can close the opposite column while retaining its size. Cancelling an opening restores the displaced column.
Partial column content blocks new touches while existing loader contacts retain their original global mapping. Explicit close, track selection change and interruption cancel the loader.
The detail header keeps one loader mounted at full size and hides optional artwork at narrow widths. The list toolbar has a compact fallback.
Search, selection, queue, playlist storage, loading commands and musical actions use their existing paths.
limits: Physical gesture delivery, scrolling, both loader ends, compact headers and clean audio need Erik acceptance.
Sizes last for the session. Very small windows cannot fit the optional columns.
This does not establish original TDJ1 gesture or sound equivalence.
